taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: EventBridge producer identity, routing and consumer trust
controls.source_trace: Determine whether untrusted producers can set fields the consumer treats as an authenticated tenant or action instruction.
controls.implementation_branch: An event detail field claiming a tenant or user is application data, not the caller identity authenticated by the bus. Evaluate PutEvents admission, routing rule scope and consumer validation independently. Service-originated events and custom producers have different provenance; a rule match alone does not demonstrate that a protected consumer trusts a forged identity.
controls.operational_method: Inspect PutEvents rights separately from PutRule/PutTargets and rule-update authority. Retain producer principal, source bus, selected rule and target ARN for the same synthetic event. A rule writer can redirect an otherwise authentic event; that is different from a producer forging detail fields. Verify the consumer action and intended destination with a local event-routing stub or supplied trace, without publishing real notifications.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an owned bus or local event fixture with inert markers; compare intended producer events and a controlled spoofed authority field.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Publishing to a public intake bus can be intentional; a rule match alone is not a privileged consumer effect.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Authenticate producer context and validate consumer authority, then retest rightful events and spoofed-field rejection.
